curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When old lies, local folklore, and mortality collide across three generations, what buried truth will finally refuse to stay hidden?
curatedMovie.description: In Spain, three generations of women navigate a tangled web of family secrets while enduring the fierce east wind, local superstitions, sudden fire, and the persistent presence of death.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: An emotionally heavy yet funny generational drama, moving at an engaging pace shaped by mystery and resilient family bonds.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Pedro Almodóvar, this story deftly balances heavy domestic tragedy with sharp, earthy humor, offering a resonant look at female solidarity and survival.
